title: Burst Balloons
description: Given n balloons, burst them to get max coins. Bursting i gives coins[i-1]*coins[i]*coins[i+1].
pseudocode:
1. nums = [1, ...nums, 1]
2. dp = table of size n+2 by n+2
3. for len from 1 to n:
4.   for left from 1 to n - len + 1:
5.     right = left + len - 1
6.     for k from left to right:
7.       dp[left][right] = max(dp[left][right], nums[left-1]*nums[k]*nums[right+1] + dp[left][k-1] + dp[k+1][right])

steps.note: Calculating sub-problems of length 1: Bursting single balloons
Calculating length 3: Optimal strategy yields 167 total
